file:
# Written by Elamon's dashboard editor (the web page and the app): dashboards, and the tabs,
# header and Android dashboards of profiles. A change by hand here is kept: elamond rewrites only
# the tables it is asked to. Read after the other drop-ins whose names sort before this one's.

[dashboards.mine]
title = "Mine"
icon = "gauge"

[[dashboards.mine.widgets]]
type = "gauge"
label = "CPU"
value = "cpu.usage"
max = 100
span = 2

[[dashboards.mine.widgets]]
type = "button"
label = "Echo"
action = "echo"
params = { word = "hi" }

[[dashboards.mine.widgets]]
type = "graph"
label = "Memory"
values = ["mem.percent"]

mistakes.message: a dashboard has no key command (title, icon, role, for_each, widgets)
